amends: LEARNED_COMPOSITION_OPENING_PROBE_V1_SPEC.json (supersedes its STAGE_2_LEARNED_PROBE_DECLARED_NOW_RUNS_ONLY_IF_STAGE_1_IS_VALID gate condition, which named the primary window and can never fire, since the primary sealed INSTRUMENT_NOT_VALID as a final result)
classification: DIAGNOSTIC. READ-ONLY. NO TRAINING, NO PARAMETER CHANGE, NO OUTCOME-BASED SELECTION.
authorized_by: PI direction 2026-09-20: authorize Stage 2, frozen as a dual-instrument diagnostic with no further instrument selection. Both confirmed survivors (position [5,15), intent [0,10)) are used as co-equal, separately-reported measurements: no averaging, no reweighting, no post-hoc choice of whichever tells the cleaner story. The dead primary window [0,10) position instrument is NOT used, not even as a sanity check -- its job finished at the confirmatory stage. The calibration mapping used to invert a reading into a defender count is the ORIGINAL sealed calibration (20700001-20700016); the confirmatory block (20800001-20800016) proved the ruler generalizes and does not get to reshape it -- no mapping is refit on Stage-2 or confirmatory data.

GATE_CONDITION.rule: This spec may run only if LEARNED_COMPOSITION_PROBE_CONFIRMATORY_CALIBRATION_RESULT.json is SEALED with a non-empty CONFIRMED_INSTRUMENTS list.
GATE_CONDITION.observed: Sealed 2026-09-20, VERDICT BOTH_CONFIRMED, CONFIRMED_INSTRUMENTS = [position_alt_window_5_15, intent_opening_window_0_10]. Both go forward; this spec does not choose between them.

INSTRUMENTS_USED.position_alt_window_5_15: experiments.probe_learned_composition.instrument(trace, R_pos=4.5), mean over ticks [5,15). Unmodified code path, unmodified parameters.
INSTRUMENTS_USED.intent_opening_window_0_10: experiments.probe_learned_composition.intent_instrument(trace, R_intent=4.5), mean over ticks [0,10). Unmodified code path, unmodified parameters.
INSTRUMENTS_USED.not_used: share_pos_open (position, ticks [0,10)) -- sealed INSTRUMENT_NOT_VALID on 2026-09-19 and reconfirmed not valid on fresh seeds on 2026-09-20 (FYI_PRIMARY_POSITION_OPEN_NOT_GATING). Excluded entirely from Stage 2, including as a reported diagnostic. No third instrument of any kind is introduced.

CALIBRATION_MAPPING_FROZEN.not_used_as_mapping_source: LEARNED_COMPOSITION_PROBE_CONFIRMATORY_CALIBRATION_RESULT.json. Its class_means_prefix values are read ONLY by the contracts stage, to verify they are consistent with (not a replacement for) the original mapping; they are never used to compute a learned episode's D_hat.
CALIBRATION_MAPPING_FROZEN.inversion: experiments.run_learned_composition_probe.d_hat_from(value, means): piecewise-linear interpolation of the frozen class means, clipped to [0, 6]. Per-pole means (Pole A reading uses Pole A's frozen means; Pole B uses Pole B's).
CALIBRATION_MAPPING_FROZEN.verified_by_contracts: the contracts stage re-hashes the source file and refuses if it has changed since sealing.

DESIGN.pairing: The SAME 128 seed values are used for every (policy, pole) cell, so pi_A and pi_B are paired by seed within each pole.
DESIGN.truncation_justification: Unchanged from Stage 1: a run stopped at tick 20 is bit-identical to the first 20 ticks of a full run (contract C2, original spec), verified again here for the LEARNED env by the parity check below. Both instruments read only ticks [0,15), so 20 ticks is already the minimal established-safe truncation; no new, untested truncation length is introduced.
DESIGN.action: deterministic (policy.predict(..., deterministic=True)), matching the recorded SHARE0 evaluation exactly.

READ_ONLY_GUARANTEE.checkpoint_files: sha256 of both checkpoints verified against TARGET_POLICIES_PINNED (LEARNED_COMPOSITION_OPENING_PROBE_V1_SPEC.json) before and after the run
READ_ONLY_GUARANTEE.parameters: a digest of every parameter tensor of both loaded policies is equal before and after the run
READ_ONLY_GUARANTEE.no_optimizer: no optimizer attribute exists on either loaded policy and the models are in eval mode
READ_ONLY_GUARANTEE.no_grad: the whole run executes under torch.no_grad()
READ_ONLY_GUARANTEE.why_not_a_module_check: loading a checkpoint imports rl.custom_ppo.trainer and ppo_updater, so 'no PPO module imported' cannot be asserted; the guarantee is behavioural, as in the original spec

PARITY_REQUIRED_BEFORE_ANY_EPISODE_OF_TH.rule: 16 FULL learned episodes (both policies, both poles, these 4 spent SHARE0 seeds) must reproduce the recorded (blue, red, win, margin) in share0_6v6_teacher_specialist_crossover_eval_rows.csv EXACTLY on cuda, and the first 20 ticks of each must equal a truncated (max_ticks=20) run of the same episode. Parity only; no new evidence, no registry interaction; these seeds are already spent and are not drawn from the 20700101-20700228 block.

PREREGISTERED_OUTPUTS_PER_INSTRUMENT_POL: the inferred defender-count distribution D_hat over the 128 episodes (piecewise-linear inversion of the frozen calibration mean for that pole)
mean and median D_hat, each with a bootstrap interval over seeds
proportion of episodes classified attack-heavy, D_hat <= 1.5 (the band declared in the original spec, unchanged)
the paired seedwise contrast D_hat(pi_B) - D_hat(pi_A), per pole, with a bootstrap interval
mean |D_hat - 1|, the distance from the confirmed scripted reference composition 5A/1D (D=1), with a bootstrap interval

INSTRUMENT_AGREEMENT_REPORTED_SEPARATELY.rule: Every quantity above is computed once for position_alt_window_5_15 and once for intent_opening_window_0_10, and reported side by side. No combined score, no mean-of-instruments, no weighting of one by the other is computed anywhere in this spec.
INSTRUMENT_AGREEMENT_REPORTED_SEPARATELY.descriptive_concordance_check: For each (policy, pole): does the band of mean D_hat (attack_heavy / intermediate / balanced_or_defence_heavy, thresholds 1.5 / 2.5, unchanged from the original spec) agree between the two instruments? This is descriptive bookkeeping to apply the interpretation rule below; it is not itself a statistic and gates nothing.

INTERPRETATION_RULE_FROZEN_BEFORE_ANY_LE.rule: A learned role-composition claim is made ONLY when the position and intent instruments agree qualitatively (same band, or the same direction and a comparable magnitude for a contrast). If they disagree, the finding is INSTRUMENT_DEPENDENT / INCONCLUSIVE for that cell -- not a license to report whichever instrument matches the preferred story.
INTERPRETATION_RULE_FROZEN_BEFORE_ANY_LE.not_authorized: choosing one instrument's number for a headline claim after seeing both; averaging the two D_hat values to manufacture agreement; a third instrument invented to break a disagreement.

NOT_AUTHORIZED: refitting or adjusting the calibration mapping using confirmatory-block or Stage-2 data
using the dead primary-window position instrument for any purpose
any training, checkpoint write, or forced-composition intervention on a learned team
reading a later phase of a learned episode (sustained composition) -- ticks beyond the truncation are not recorded
causal claims: this remains observational. It reports what the existing learned policies' openings resemble in scripted-equivalent units, not why, and not what a forced composition would do
claim_boundary: Scripted-role glasses: the instrument is calibrated on scripted roles. A learned policy that moves in ways scripted agents never do is read through that calibration. Observational only. Opening window only (ticks 0-15 across the two instruments). No claim about sustained role composition, and no causal claim about why pi_A and pi_B's crossover deltas were near zero.
claim_ceiling: At most: whether pi_A and pi_B's opening allocation, expressed in scripted-equivalent defender units and read through two independently-confirmed instruments, resembles the scripted 5A/1D structure that beat the balanced 3A/3D -- and whether the two policies differ from each other -- reported per instrument, with a claim made only where the instruments agree.
